boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Kettering University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Flint food stops with late hours verified on current official business pages; several are drive-thru-only after dining rooms close.

cards.title: The All-Hours Diner Run
cards.subtitle: A 24/7 diner on Corunna Road
cards.notes: Head west on Corunna Road for a sit-down diner menu at any hour; check the official site before leaving in case operations change.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock option for breakfast, dinner, dessert, carryout, or drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: Mega Classic Diner's official website lists its address as 4462 Corunna Road in Flint and states that it is open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: The official site currently says OPEN 24/7 and lists carryout and drive-thru service.

cards.title: The Pierson Road Dinner Run
cards.subtitle: A local restaurant serving until 1 a.m. on weekends
cards.notes: Save this west-side run for Friday or Saturday, when the published schedule extends later; confirm hours before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A locally named restaurant with a weekend window that reaches past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Prime Eight Ten's official site identifies the restaurant at 4418 West Pierson Road in Flint and lists Friday and Saturday hours from 1 p.m. to 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 1 p.m.–1 a.m. Friday and Saturday; Sunday through Tuesday and Thursday close at 11 p.m., and Wednesday is closed.

cards.title: The Midnight Corunna Road Run
cards.subtitle: Restaurant and drive-thru service through midnight
cards.notes: Use this Corunna Road stop when a midnight closing is late enough, and place a mobile order only after verifying the location is accepting it.
cards.short_summary: A predictable midnight cutoff with both restaurant and drive-thru hours published directly.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official location page lists 4314 Corunna Road in Flint and gives restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6 a.m. to midnight every day.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 4314 Corunna Road in Flint, MI
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently lists both restaurant and drive-thru service until 12 a.m. daily.

cards.title: The Clio Road 2 A.M. Run
cards.subtitle: Late restaurant, lobby, and drive-thru hours
cards.notes: Choose this north-side stop when the group needs service after midnight; review the live location page before departing campus.
cards.short_summary: A seven-day late option whose published schedule extends to 2 a.m. most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's official page for 3212 Clio Road in Flint lists restaurant, lobby, and drive-thru service until 2 a.m. Monday through Saturday and 1 a.m. Sunday.
cards.source_title: McDonald's at 3212 Clio Road, Flint, MI
cards.access_notes: Restaurant, lobby, and drive-thru hours currently end at 2 a.m. Monday–Saturday and 1 a.m. Sunday.

cards.title: The Dort Highway 5 A.M. Run
cards.subtitle: An overnight drive-thru south of downtown
cards.notes: Plan on drive-thru access after the dining room closes, and designate a driver before making this overnight Dort Highway trip.
cards.short_summary: An overnight fast-food option with a published 5 a.m. drive-thru closing every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page lists 1740 South Dort Highway in Flint and drive-thru hours from 8 a.m. until 5 a.m. seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 1740 South Dort Highway, Flint, MI
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru hours are currently 8 a.m.–5 a.m. daily; the posted dine-in schedule closes much earlier.

cards.title: The Corunna Road 5 A.M. Run
cards.subtitle: An overnight drive-thru west of campus
cards.notes: Use a vehicle for the late window because the dining room closes earlier; verify the official page before starting this westbound run.
cards.short_summary: A Corunna Road branch with overnight drive-thru hours extending to early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page identifies 3606 Corunna Road in Flint and lists drive-thru hours from 8 a.m. to 5 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 3606 Corunna Road, Flint, MI
cards.access_notes: The drive-thru is currently posted as open until 5 a.m. daily; dine-in hours end at 8 p.m. on the displayed schedule.

cards.title: The Pierson Road 3 A.M. Run
cards.subtitle: A northwestern Flint drive-thru open overnight
cards.notes: Keep this branch for a northwestern Flint run, using the drive-thru after dine-in service ends and confirming hours before departure.
cards.short_summary: A Pierson Road alternative whose drive-thru schedule reaches 3 a.m. throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page lists 4382 West Pierson Road in Flint and shows drive-thru hours from 9 a.m. to 3 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 4382 West Pierson Road, Flint, MI
cards.access_notes: The official page currently lists drive-thru service until 3 a.m. every day; posted dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: The Fenton Road 3:30 A.M. Run
cards.subtitle: A weekend drive-thru stretching past 3 a.m.
cards.notes: Pick Friday or Saturday for the latest posted window, travel by car, and check the location page because dine-in service ends earlier.
cards.short_summary: A south Flint branch with its longest drive-thru hours on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page lists 4903 Fenton Road in Flint and shows drive-thru service until 3 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and 3:30 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 4903 Fenton Road, Flint, MI
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru service currently ends at 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: The Hill Road 2 A.M. Run
cards.subtitle: A daily late drive-thru near the southern retail corridor
cards.notes: Use this branch for the Hill Road corridor and expect drive-thru service after the lobby closes; verify live hours before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A consistent 2 a.m. drive-thru choice on Flint's south side.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page identifies 2479 Hill Road in Flint and lists drive-thru hours from 8 a.m. to 2 a.m. seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 2479 Hill Road, Flint, MI
cards.access_notes: The location's drive-thru is currently posted until 2 a.m. daily; the displayed dine-in hours end at 11 p.m.

cards.title: The Linden Road 1 A.M. Run
cards.subtitle: A seven-day drive-thru option west of Interstate 75
cards.notes: Choose this branch when 1 a.m. fits the plan, and arrive by vehicle after dine-in closes; recheck the official schedule first.
cards.short_summary: A Linden Road fallback with a drive-thru open one hour past midnight every night.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page lists 3383 South Linden Road in Flint and gives drive-thru hours from 8 a.m. to 1 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 3383 South Linden Road, Flint, MI
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru service is currently listed until 1 a.m. daily; posted dine-in hours end at 10 p.m.

warnings: Six cards are separate Taco Bell destinations because few nearby businesses publish current late-night hours on direct official pages.
Late-night access at the Taco Bell cards may be drive-thru-only; confirm vehicle access and live operating status before departure.
Coordinates and maps URLs are null because they were not independently verified from authoritative direct sources in this research pass.
